text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was the moment to attack, attack, and 
attack! So why did my legs freeze up like 
that...?!
choice_data_list:
What's happened has happened— it can't be 
helped

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yeah, you're right. ...I wonder if 
resting will fix it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard the faint sound of teeth 
grinding in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...'If you've got time for that, look 
forward and prepare for the next race,' 
huh."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right. We can't just leave things like 
this without takin' any countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I know in my head that it's no good, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, Tamamo Cross just stared up 
at the ceiling of the waiting room.
